title: pm-daily-scratchpad-2026-03-20
content:
Morning priorities (top 3)
- Finalize PRD edits for streaming tool-calls section (incorporate security review notes from Priya).
- Sync with Marco on dedicated rollout timing + infra gating items.
- Triage regressions from canary run (latency spike around 95th pctl).

Quick to-dos (today)
- [ ] Merge PRD changes into /product-hosted-api/PRD (target: noon)
- [ ] Post update to #product-launch (one-line TL;DR + action items)
- [ ] Schedule follow-up with infra SREs for the dedicated capacity autoscale test (Fri)
- [ ] Add canary test cases to smoke-runner (edge-case: long prompt + streaming)
- [ ] Draft customer comms for limited early access cohort (short + clear on SLA expectations)

PRD edits notes (streaming & tool-calls)
- Change: examples for function-calling streaming responses — add a small section that shows chunked JSON outputs and error handling (see Marco's snippet).
- Security note from Priya: ensure KMS key rotation section has explicit rollback steps — add step-by-step and whom to notify (secops + legal).
- Metrics: add SLOs for 95th and 99th latency for streaming vs non-streaming endpoints. Link to Observe dashboard: CONFLUENCE-DB-742 (metrics table).
- Outstanding question: do we require request-level entitlement check before streaming starts or after first chunk? (Pinged Priya, awaiting guidance).

Meetings
- 09:00 sync (product standup) — flagged rollout date drift. Action: update timeline slide.
- 10:30 infra deep-dive with Marco & SRE (notes)
  - Autoscale policy: default target util 70% -> re-evaluate for Dedicated GPU pools. Marco to run 1h stress test next Tue.
  - Observed artifact: KV cache warm-up causing token rate dips on canary. Hypothesis: cache miss storm on new model variant. SRE to instrument cache-hit rate by model_version.
- 15:00 stakeholder review (sales + CS) — prep 1-slide summary + risks list (I'll send at 13:30)

Stakeholder follow-ups (message drafts / owners)
- Sales (Jordan): short note confirming GA not before reserved capacity SLA is validated. Keep optional early access. (Action: DM Jordan after 15:00 review)
- CS (Maya): need to align on onboarding doc + sample configs for customers migrating from hosted -> dedicated. Priya to co-author.
- Security (Priya): waiting on final KMS wording — aim to resolve by EOD.

Launch checklist (short-list, needs validation)
- PRD reviewed and merged (owner: me)
- Runbook: ops + rollback steps written (owner: Marco)
- Canaries: 2 successful runs with no 95th-pctl regressions (owner: SRE)
- Observability: dashboards + alerts configured (owner: observability team)
- Docs: onboarding + API examples (owner: devex)
- Customer comms: headcount for replies (CS assigned: Maya)
- Legal: SLA template ready (owner: legal)

Blockers & risks
- Blocking: KMS rollback wording not approved -> blocks Private deployment docs. (Severity: high for Private customers)
- Risk: if autoscale policy too aggressive, we could see instability during burst tests -> might delay Dedicated GA by 1 sprint. Need test results by next Tue.
- Minor: some example code in SDK PR is out-of-date with recent headers; left comments on PR #987.

Decisions / recent outcomes
- Agreed with Marco: run 1h stress test on Tue, results to determine autoscale defaults.
- Agreed with Priya: KMS rotation steps to include security contact list + automated alert to secops; final wording by EOD or escalate to legal.

Notes to self (rough)
- When editing PRD, keep examples compact — customers skim. Move deep details to appendix.
- Add numbered checklist for on-call (who does what at T+0, T+5m, T+30m).
- Revisit cost-optimization section; need a short paragraph that explains batching tradeoffs in plain English for sales.

Open questions / follow-ups
- Priya: entitlement check before first chunk? (waiting)
- Marco: can we simulate cache-miss storm locally or only in cluster? (Marco will check)
- DevEx: who owns updating SDK examples for function-calls streaming? (ping Maya)

Tomorrow (top priorities)
- Finalize PRD + send to stakeholders for sign-off
- Validate canary run results & triage any regressions
- Prep slide for 15:00 review with clear ask + proposed launch date

Random quick notes (brain dump)
- Customer X asked about per-route quotas in Dedicated — add to backlog (feature request).
- Consider short FAQ for early-access customers: "What to expect during canary"

End of day checklist
- [ ] Merge PRD
- [ ] Post update to #product-launch
- [ ] Send slide to stakeholders by 13:30
summary: Daily PM scratchpad: PRD edits for streaming/tool-calls, infra sync on autoscale and cache warm-up, canary triage, launch checklist, stakeholder follow-ups. Blocking issue: KMS rollback wording from security/legal.
